verdict.rationale: Notification tuning is a fair axis for a chat/collaboration product like Teams, but the evidence pack has no first-party documentation of per-channel, keyword-based, or scheduled notification controls. The connectors item is about subscribing to messages from external web services, which is a different feature. Community reports go the other way: users say they cannot mute or unsubscribe from channels and cannot fully shut off notifications. With no vendor claim to contradict, this is "none" rather than "disputed".
